Image 2 defines the camera: strict LEFT profile, nose pointing screen LEFT. All EIGHT poses face SCREEN LEFT without turning, including bottom row. Carry the same log on the same right shoulder in every pose, never waist carry. Walk in place: top row left foot contact, left loading, right foot passing, right advancing; bottom row right foot contact, right loading, left foot passing, left advancing. Clearly alternating lead feet, body stable. Same face/clothes/proportions/lighting/camera and log dimensions in every frame. Semi realistic detailed painted 3D game sprite as references. Fit each entire dwarf AND entire log comfortably inside its own cell with generous transparent margin on ALL four sides. No cropped objects, no labels, no scenery, no ground, no shadows, no extra limbs.
